entities.name: Service area restrictions
entities.description: Network functionality that restricts service access based on geographic area. Applicable only to 3GPP access and wireline access.

entities.name: 3GPP access
entities.description: Access type where UE connects to 5GCN via 3GPP radio access network.

entities.name: Wireline access
entities.description: Access type where 5G-RG or W-AGF connects to 5GCN via wireline network.

entities.name: UE access over 3GPP access
entities.description: Condition when UE accesses 5GCN over 3GPP access.

entities.name: Wireline access by 5G-RG or W-AGF
entities.description: Condition when 5G-RG or W-AGF acting on behalf of FN-CRG or N5GC device accesses 5GCN over wireline access.

relations.description: Service area restrictions are applicable to 3GPP access.
Service area restrictions are applicable to wireline access.
When UE accesses over 3GPP access, service area restrictions apply as specified in subclause 5.3.5.2.
When 5G-RG or W-AGF accesses over wireline access, service area restrictions apply as specified in subclause 5.3.5.3.
